name: Shenzhou 10 Guidao Cang
about: Shenzhou 10 Guidao Cang (2013-029H), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou OM), launched 2013 Jun 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2013 Jun 26), held fixed
